verifiedSourceContracts.contract: Custom record contains modelId/displayName/description/contextWindowSize(default128000), instance or legacy endpoint, thinkingEnabled(false), text input/output+toolCalling defaults, capabilities object, providerOptions object, string-valued headers.

Dialog seeds exact instance; model/display trimmed; global collision with built-in or other custom ID rejects; JSON parse errors retain draft; save in progress blocks dismissal; failed save keeps dialog and error.
Main form includes model/display/description/context, instance, thinking and modality/tool capability flags; provider-options and header JSON are advanced fields.
Custom cards are instance-grouped with display name, context and edit/delete actions; belong in the model list rather than discovery inventory.
Edit replaces exact originally edited modelId, add appends, delete removes exact modelId; no automatic rewrite of saved preset/chat references shown in these handlers.

Selector uses (instanceId,modelId), custom metadata/context label, disabled preference filtering, custom over discovered collision, and utility exclusion of external agents. Resolver includes disabled entries so hiding is not disabling saved execution.

Explicit missing instance fails; matching custom wins before built-in/discovered on that exact instance. Custom route resolves API spec and wire modelId; passes custom headers, wraps flat custom providerOptions under actual API-spec provider key (OpenAI variants use openai), returns custom context and reasoning-signature identity.
Provider removal atomically removes related custom models and instance thinking overrides; saved references are not silently redirected by the explicit-instance resolver.
Normal inference consumes resolved headers/options; context window affects read limits. Capability lookup is separate and keyed by modelId.
Title generation retains custom headers/options while applying its documented utility thinking override policy.
Compression forwards resolved provider options and headers.
Pinned core adapter capabilities read global getModelCapabilities(modelId), not preferences customModels.
Unknown/custom ID capability fallback is text-only and toolCalling true. Therefore stored custom capabilities are not proven to govern core input preparation in this pinned path.

behavior: Exact-provider add/edit/move/rename/delete with DPAPI private payload + atomic repository CAS.
Private options and headers never enter publicJson/runtime persistence; request binding validates exact provider/model before post.
Context metadata, tool and bounded image capability reach real native Engine/Host requests.
Existing hidden custom selections stay runnable; deleted IDs remain visibly unavailable unless a verified discovered replacement exists.
Queued turns pause after same-ID binding edits/deletion without interrupting active response or dropping queued history; resume re-resolves selection.
Actual main.cpp --smoke uses the canonical resolver and honors explicit CLI overrides; removed definition is refused before network.
Custom-containing envelopes use version2; existing ordinary format1 remains readable and ordinarily saved without upgrade.
Advanced JSON controls collapsed by default, with retained drafts, dynamic light/dark palette and reachable350px controls.
compatibilityDifferencesAndLimits: Per-instance encrypted configuration under ProviderStore CAS replaces source global preference array; global custom model ID uniqueness preserved.
Unsupported native request/media variants fail explicitly; audio/video/file input and non-text output controls are disabled except clearing imported true declarations.
Image input declaration is honored with native byte/pixel bounds; pinned host capability lookup did not include custom definitions.
Runtime explicit utility/selection overrides apply after custom options; pinned custom factory omitted generic thinking override resolution.
Retired IDs prevent deleted custom definitions silently becoming legacy provider defaults; no unrelated marker eviction.
Models dialog uses a native list plus Add/Edit/Delete actions rather than source card-inline icon placement.
JSON advanced editor remains plain text, with source-like editable object configuration and validation.
Supported HTTP option subset only; unsupported/protected fields fail explicitly. No full AI SDK/options or pixel-parity claim.
Custom HTTP model definitions do not alter Codex/Claude/OpenCode managed model inventories.

Public/saved projection excludes private headers/options; diagnostic redaction is bounded and does not rewrite successful model-authored content. Smoke capture additionally redacts saved custom header values.
Provider probe remains dotenv-imported discovery validation; it has no saved custom-provider store input. Actual ADE --smoke now resolves saved definitions via the same ModelSelection resolver.
Per-instance retired-ID capacity256 returns an explicit error instead of evicting unrelated markers and reviving deleted IDs.
Source form supports more modalities; native text plus bounded image input and tools are implemented. Other media declarations explicitly fail runtime validation.
No real provider credentials, user profiles, live remote services, desktop input or production changes were used in this stage.
Full combined root gate and packaged Windows UI remain pending; private coherent host passed.
